parsed.explanation: The omitted lemma is exactly the required large-prime-erasure mechanism. No induction hypothesis, construction, or all-terms argument is supplied. The later reference to “The construction Rp^k” merely asserts that such a repair exists, without defining R, p, or k or proving the resulting integer is an earlier term with the required support. Computational checks are expressly not proof. Thus (3), and consequently the periodicity argument depending on it, are unjustified as written; a full lemma proof is required.
